regressions.source: UsdcVault.permit: require(SignatureChecker-style isValidSignature(...) == 0x1626ba7e, 'UsdcVault/invalid-permit'); allowance[owner][spender] = value; emit Approval(owner, spender, value)
regressions.issue: The revert reason string is lost: it prints as Error(string) memory writes and a raw 'revert with memory' whose length keeps '_64 - mem[64]'. The Approval value prints as a memory slice instead of amount. The cause is the free-pointer update now printed in the 'else' arm after the isValidSignature call: after the join mem[64] is unknown, so _62/_64 are opaque and are no longer matched to the following mem[64] reads. Same values (lengths 32 and 100).
regressions.rule: A variable bound to a read of mem[64] equals any later read of mem[64] as long as no write to mem[64] comes between, even when the value of mem[64] is unknown after a join. Fold x - mem[64] to 0, forward the words written at mem[x] to their reads, and then recognize the Error(string) revert and the event data as before.

regressions.issue: The encoded length is forwarded from its write into every use instead of the bound variable _47, and in the padding address ceil32 shows up as '2 * Mask(250, 5, signature.length + 31)'. Same values, harder to read.
regressions.rule: Keep a length word read back from memory as its variable when the forwarded expression is longer. Print 2 * (x + 31 & ~31) as 2 * ceil32(x) and keep the sum in its original form.

improvements: initialize's Initializable slot no longer factored by 3600 (P1 2 -> 0). 0x0100...00 * v in permit's ecrecover packing shown with whole bytes (P6 1 -> 0).
notes: Diff of 76 lines over 3 functions (initialize, two hunks in permit), read in full. The new permit tail is semantically equal to the old: same check, write, event and revert data, with the if-arms swapped and an explicit stop. Only the display regressed. Pack regex P2 2 lines.
summary: One medium readability regression: in permit's ERC-1271 path the 'UsdcVault/invalid-permit' revert string and the Approval value fall back to raw memory, because the free pointer becomes unknown after a join. The Initializable-slot P1 is fixed.
